description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/askseedit route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-askseedit-directory.json
rules: Ask a clear, direct, open-ended question, and end the title with a question mark.
Keep questions broadly answerable; do not request personal, medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
Do not post loaded questions, surveys, either-or prompts, or questions with one factual answer.
Do not post or request personal information, target specific people, or encourage harassment.
Be civil; no bigotry, threats, sexualization of minors, or encouragement of self-harm.
Treat [Serious] posts sincerely and keep replies relevant to the question.
No spam, promotion, begging, vote manipulation, or automated low-effort content.
